name: MNRE
full: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy, RE-RTD

rules.privateCostShare: Private institutes and industry may receive up to 50% support (70% for low-to-high TRL upgrades with endorsement). Show your cost share.

rertd.name: RE Research & Technology Development (RE-RTD)
tips: State the TRL at the beginning and at the end of the project: the call asks for both.
MNRE funds technology development and demonstration toward manufacture and deployment. Show the commercialisation path and cost per unit against what is on the market.
Up to 100% support for government and academic institutions; up to 50% for industry, start-ups and private institutes (up to 70% for low-to-high TRL upgrades with endorsement). Plan any cost share.
Clearly define objectives and list the deliverables. Industry participation strengthens the case.
